Edward, saw Local Express partnered with LOC Software to deliver unified commerce for grocers.

New partnerships like that usually open up more grocer accounts than the team can work before momentum fades, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Local Express off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Local Express needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
